charge_port.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: IONIQ 5 (2026 MY onwards) has a NACS port; N not named separately.
US article: NACS becomes standard on the 2026 IONIQ 5 N (2025 N was CCS1 per The Charge Port).

supercharger_access.notes: Through its NACS port (same FAQ statement for IONIQ 5 2026+).

adapters_included.notes: electrive and KBB: the 2026 IONIQ 5 N switched to a NACS port and includes CCS adapters. (Hyundai's adapter FAQ predates the 2026 N.)

heat_pump.notes: Estimated: 2027 Canadian N page lists "Heat pump, battery thermal management and preconditioning system" in the performance section; 2026 assumed the same.

wheels.notes: CarGurus: standard 21 in forged wheels on the 2026 N; Hyundai Canada 2027 page says N-exclusive 21 in forged alloys with 275/35R21 Pirelli P-Zero.
